note: Epic-level register. Detailed acceptance criteria are in CODING_AGENT_ROADMAP.md. Each epic must be refined into bounded work items during Grounding; do not execute the whole epic as one agent prompt.

epics.title: Repository, source inventory and build baseline
epics.outcome: Create a reproducible EMBERFALL repo, verify code/assets provenance, find the SLAY! prototype if available, pin toolchain, baseline build and test commands.

epics.title: Gameplay rules contract and P0 decisions
epics.outcome: Convert the v0.2 specification into executable, versioned rules and resolve P0 ambiguities before dependent implementation.

epics.title: Headless board engine and deterministic group-pop simulation
epics.outcome: Implement deterministic 7×7 board, connected groups, pops, vertical gravity, Ink, chip damage, Spectrum Run, neutral blocks and Wall prototype.

epics.title: Turn state machine, player/enemy combat and telegraphed intents
epics.outcome: Implement Draw/Weave/Cast/Wall/Enemy/Cleanup phases, Vigil, Block, Flasks, enemy intents and atomic legal actions.

epics.title: Data-driven card, cost, upgrade and effect engine
epics.outcome: Implement typed card content schema, deterministic effect resolver, trigger queue, payment, Pop/Recolor/Fuse/Spawn/Shatter/Draw/Taps/Delay/Exhaust/Retain/Echo.

epics.title: Three playable class identities and starter decks
epics.outcome: Implement Ashen Monk, Quarry Witch, The Unlit, signature mechanics, relics and validated 12-card starter decks.

epics.title: Enemy, elite and phased boss content system
epics.outcome: Implement data-driven enemy patterns, board attacks, 2-intent preview, elites and three-phase core bosses.

epics.title: Run map, rewards, shops, bonfires, events and covenants
epics.outcome: Implement 3 acts, 15-row branching map, node validation, Cinders, rewards, shop, bonfire, events, Covenants, Ascension and per-node saves.

epics.title: Death, Shade encounters, Remnants and narrative progression
epics.outcome: Persist dead-deck identity, generate bounded Shade encounter, recover Cinders/Remnant, implement codex, NPC secrets and endings.

epics.title: Android app shell, portrait combat UI and touch UX
epics.outcome: Build portrait Android client with corridor/board/hand composition, touch routing, preview, drag, undo, accessibility and navigation.

epics.title: Art assets, manifests, atlases and game-world presentation
epics.outcome: Integrate approved art, traceable source/license metadata, atlases, animations, environment layers and game-event-driven VFX.

epics.title: Dynamic music, sound effects, lighting response and haptics
epics.outcome: Implement hue-note mapping, pop voicing, adaptive ambience, card/enemy SFX, haptics, audio controls and measured latency.

epics.title: Versioned saves, action logs and deterministic replay
epics.outcome: Implement atomic saves, migrations, recovery, seed/version/action logs and deterministic replay/checkpoint verification.

epics.title: Bot policies, seeded sweeps and balance dashboard
epics.outcome: Build greedy and lookahead bots, reproducible sweeps, archetype metrics, dashboards and exploit scans.

epics.title: Complete v1.0 content catalogue
epics.outcome: Populate 360 cards, 150 relics, 36 regular enemies, 12 elites, 3 bosses, 50 events and 400 codex entries or approved cut list.

epics.title: Daily seeds, leaderboard and replay validation service
epics.outcome: Add optional daily seeds, leaderboard and replay validation without mandatory accounts or blocking offline play.

epics.title: Device QA, performance, accessibility and launch hardening
epics.outcome: Complete device matrix, 60fps target verification, crash/performance, accessibility, legal, store policy, Mastery and Repetition.
